headline: With wildfires raging in France and Spain, fire crews race against next heat wave
context: French authorities ordered nearly 4,000 people evacuated Tuesday from tourist sites on the Atlantic coast as returning heat threatened firefighters' fragile hold on a vast wildfire west of Bordeaux.

sources.name: NPR
